notes.title: Mini update - additional help sign
notes.content:
Added a reminder in a later level that all parked cars can be dragged.
Added a sign that hanged billboards can be moved.

notes.title: A first post-launch Update made! [based on reviews and feedback]
notes.content:
A first post-launch update was made based on received reviews and feedback. Taking all of them into consideration, some corrections and improvements were implemented:
[olist]
[*] Specified more clearly where to arrange items in the Yard Sale and Flower Arranging levels.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44734785/4c68dd4e3dfbafaa556f73d7e88ba10a42c9b49a.png[/img]
[*] Corrected grammatical errors. Most of which were found in the first four to five levels.
[*] Made some of the secretly hidden items just a little bit more noticeable, especially the place where the black cat prowls at night~. Also provided a small explanation in the Main Menu.
[*] Made a couple of later tasks easier by adding small visual hints.
[*] Repaired some sounds that were accidentally muted.
[*] Birds on the 15th level disappeared too soon, so their flight was prolonged.
[*] Mapped the left/right keys for map movement.
[*] Repaired one unset UI reference in 10th level.
[/olist]

notes.title: Added option “Mute all but the found sound”.
notes.content:
[b]Added option to settings:[/b] [i]“Mute all but the found sound”[/i] to both the Demo and Full game.
- Now you can listen to your own music and not miss your success!

(Though, in a couple of tasks sound is a helpful clue. But not necessary.)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44734785/b97b10c04b8b9a4f2322a7d408f1f1a4586db57a.png[/img]
[b]Also some small changes were made to the Demo's first level[/b], mostly to make the "[i]mold task[/i]" a bit easier. Though, beware! Tasks later in the full game will take a lot more time and work then in this short demo~
